CUSTOM TRAINING

Custom Training

Adapt an object detector to an annotated dataset.

Service scope

A fine-tuning service for customer-annotated object detection datasets is in preparation. Intake dates and contact details will follow confirmation.

From intake to delivery

IntakeConfirm data rights, label definitions, class mapping and intended use
ValidationPlanned inputs: COCO JSON / YOLO TXT. Inspect image pairing, coordinates, splits and duplicates.
Training and evaluationUse agreed training and holdout splits, then record results.
Proposed deliveryWeights, validated ONNX, evaluation report and setup guide.

Pricing and data handling

Pricing, limits and lead time will be quoted from validation effort, compute time and deliverables. No accuracy level is guaranteed. Purpose, storage, access, retention, deletion and confidentiality must be agreed before transfer.
